Tweaks: YTLite, DontEatMyContent, MaxTubeExtras, YouTubeDislikesReturn, YouGroupSettings, YouChooseQuality, YouGetCaption, YouLoop, YouMute, YouPiP, YouShare, YouSpeed +7

This is a mod for YouTube on iOS/iPadOS, featuring over hundred customizable options but with the latest version of YTPlus/YTLite freed and with more tweaks than the original YouTube Plus.
This includes the following tweaks:
YouPiP, YTUHD, YouQuality, RYD, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent,YTweaks, Gonerino, YouSpeed, YTLowContrastMode (my fork with a setting section), YouGetCaption, YouChooseQuality, YouShare, YouLoop, YouMute, YTLocalQueue, MaxTube Extras and OpenInYouTube Safari Extension. You can see more information about this mod at: https://github.com/Mark02-2012/MaxTube
